text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I was merely tracing the contours of my 
own body.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, lately— I have been going to—the 
Mejiro family dinners.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please do not misunderstand. The 
Mejiro family is not in the wrong in the 
slightest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Cause and responsibility are fundamentally 
two different things.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Every single problem in this world—it's 
all my fault.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I only meant to ask a little about your 
family, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, Mejiro Ramonu frequented the 
gym and regained her perfect figure with 
no rebound.
